evidence_role: Existing 53-MOS ideal-interconnect sizing-screen control underlying the fourth waveform curve; not the original long-channel source or a new-layout extracted simulation.
source_family_relation: All 53 family identities and terminal connections match the later unit control. The one sized PMOS represented as NF4 here becomes two parallel NF2 devices later; all other 52 family declarations are identical. Numerical equivalence is measured rather than assumed.

sizing_changes.kind: New follow-up design, with two sensing-inverter transistor sizing changes; not a P&R-only repair of the historical experiment.

model_scope.family: Public PTM-MG 14 nm high-performance NFET and PFET predictive compact models
model_scope.simulation_corner: One nominal predictive-model condition; no process-corner distribution or mismatch sweep.
model_scope.provenance: Model identity is established from the archived NFET/PFET files and their model-card comments. No transistor models are distributed in this results-only supplement.
